JPN.ko: 경제 채널에서만 움직임이 포착되었다. 한국과 일본의 주택금융기관이 협력 협약을 체결한 사건이 유일한 근거이나, 근거 1건이라 일관된 추세를 단정하기 어렵다.
JPN.en: Movement was detected only in the economic channel. The sole evidence is a cooperation pact signed between South Korea and Japan's housing finance agencies, but with only one source, it is difficult to establish a consistent trend.

sources.title: Japan, South Korea Housing Finance Agencies Sign Cooperation Pact | IBTimes JP

CHN.ko: 한국이 중국 노선을 확대하고 저비용항공사(LCC)에 더 많은 항공권을 부여하는 조치를 취했다. 이는 경제 채널에서 한국 → 중국 방향으로 -1.0의 지수 변화를 기록했으나, 근거가 1건뿐이라 이 조치의 전반적 영향을 단정하기 어렵다.
CHN.en: South Korea expanded China routes and granted additional flight rights to low-cost carriers. This resulted in a -1.0 index change in the economic channel from South Korea toward China, but with only one source report, it is difficult to conclusively assess the broader implications of this measure.

sources.title: S. Korea expands China routes, gives more flight rights to LCCs - The Korea Herald

PRK.ko: 북한의 군사 위협이 지수를 주도했다. 북한이 미국과 남한을 향해 핵무기로 위협하고 새로운 전투체계를 시험했다는 보도가 긴장도를 높였다. 한편 한국은 2020년 남북공동연락사무소 폭파에 대해 국제법적 대응으로 북한에 배상금 지급을 명령하는 외교적 조치를 취했다.
PRK.en: North Korea's military threats drove the escalation index upward. Reports of North Korea threatening nuclear weapons against the US and South Korea, along with tests of new combat systems, heightened tensions. In response, South Korea pursued diplomatic measures through a court order mandating North Korea pay compensation for the 2020 destruction of the inter-Korean liaison office.

USA.en: North Korea's strong criticism of the US-South Korea-Japan nuclear submarine cooperation drove up military tensions from the US to South Korea. Meanwhile, South Korea's Foreign Minister Cho Hyun's visit to Washington and the postponement of investment negotiations with the US contributed to lowering tensions from South Korea to the US through diplomatic and economic channels.

PRK.en: North Korea emphasized the irreversibility of its nuclear status through military statements, while South Korea responded with diplomatic conditions for dialogue and legislative discussions on easing civilian contact restrictions. North Korea's military threat level (+0.86) outweighed South Korea's diplomatic de-escalation approach (-1.50).
